up: Find all distinct compounds tested against the human CB2 receptor in human assays. Return the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for each compound. Order the results by ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE pref_name = 'Cannabinoid CB2 receptor' AND organism = 'Homo sapiens') AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
